استعبدن (form X)
# اِسْتَعْبَدْنَ (istaʕbadna) /is.taʕ.bad.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَعْبَدَ (istaʕbada)
# اُسْتُعْبِدْنَ (ustuʕbidna) /us.tuʕ.bid.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَعْبَدَ (istaʕbada)
# اِسْتَعْبِدْنَ (istaʕbidna) /is.taʕ.bid.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَعْبَدَ (istaʕbada)
